content: Sabat gulet diniŋ mede
Tiŋa mindaŋkade Sabat foloŋ Jesu adi mihiŋiye dut wit fiye gineŋ talik ugiŋ. Uŋila mihiŋiye adi map nadiŋa wit folooŋ wootitiila kaipmuŋ nagiŋ.
Kaŋ Falisi hekidi yabuŋa nadiune tuwot mu tubune Jesu indiŋ niŋgiŋ, “Yodoko Medenikdi Sabat foloŋ kwanai mu titiŋdok yolak kaŋ mihigeye adi maŋgoŋde unduŋ tiiŋ?”
Unduŋ yobu Jesudibo yeniŋguk, “Hidi Dewit tiŋa meŋiyedi map nadiŋa tigiŋ u mube kunali nadiiŋ?

Dewit adi wooŋ Bepaŋ’walaŋ Siloŋyotneŋ fooŋ Bepaŋdok belet uŋgoniŋ yoŋa kamegiŋ u tiŋa naaŋ meŋiye yembune nagiŋ. Kaŋ Yodoko Medenikdi unduŋ mu titiŋdok yoŋit, adi Siloŋyot diniŋ talitimeŋdi hogok nanaŋdok yoŋit.
“Be Siloŋyot diniŋ talitimeŋ heki’walaŋ Yodoko Mede hatak u mube kunatnadiiŋ? Talitimeŋ heki Sabat foloŋ kwanai mu titiŋdok yoŋit adi u lahula Siloŋyotneŋ kwanai tubune wendi yom mu tilak.
“Nu indiŋ hanimbene nadineŋ. Me niŋ namandahik foloŋ yatak adiyeŋ Siloŋyot kalakapmelak.

Bepaŋ’walaŋ Youkudip Mede gineŋ mede niŋ indiŋ yolak, ‘Bepaŋ adi kale hemundumunduŋe timindok adi moŋ nadilak, adi yadi me noli siloŋ tiyemdok nadilak.’ Hidi mede u nadiyaneŋ binemek adi me yomhinit mokit yeniŋtofit mu taneŋ.
Me Kobumuŋ adi Sabat maaŋ kadokolak.”
Sabat gulet nai foloŋ Jesudi me niŋ kohoŋ hogoli tutumbaguk
Unduŋ yodapmaaŋ nai uŋaniŋgoŋ wooŋ Judahi’walaŋ bopyotneŋ foguk

kaŋ me niŋ kohoŋ kumuŋ tuguk adi uŋgoŋ ikuk. Kaŋ mehekidi Jesu mede gineŋ deti kamenim yoŋa indiŋ niŋkamandagiŋ, “Yodoko Medenikdi dediŋ yolak. Sabat foloŋ meeniŋ kedem be yehitubu-kedebadok, be dediŋ?”
Kaŋ Jesudibo indiŋ tubu-udaneyemguk, “Hidi’walaaniŋ nebek niŋ dompaŋiŋ Sabat foloŋ koŋ gineŋ binek fowek, kaŋ Sabat foloŋ doktiŋa kedembe bikabune uŋgoŋ halek?
Dompadi nemek folooŋ mu tilak, meeniŋ adi nemek uŋgoniŋ hinek, unduŋ doktiŋa Yodoko Mededi Sabat foloŋ me yehitubu-loda kedem titiŋdok yolak.”
Unduŋ yoŋa me kohoŋ kumuŋ u niŋguk, “Kohoge kihiwaleŋ.” Nimbune kohoŋ kihiwali utumbahinakaune fukuniŋ dabugoŋ tuguk.
Unduŋ tubune Falisi heki adi u kaŋ wooŋ Jesu uutdok yohebet tigiŋ.
Polofetdi Jesudok kigili mede yoguk u agaŋ folooŋ mintaguk
Kaŋ Jesu adi mede u nadiŋa yokwet u bikabuŋa kwet niŋkade uguk. Kaŋ metam feedi keletaune yagithinit yehitubu-kedebaguk.
Tiŋa Jesudi kwanai u tuguk, u metam noli mebiŋiŋ mu yenindok yoŋa yenihep tuguk.
Kaŋ Bepaŋdi polofet Aisaiya maŋiŋ gineŋ mede indiŋ yoguk u folooŋ mintaguk,

content.text: “I na’walaŋ tipilapilaye-me, adi nagoŋ tubudakalegut. Adi kanadigalika tilat, tiŋa welenedi hinek kahile tilat. Unduŋ doktiŋa Uŋgoniŋ Munabuline ugolomimbene metam fekhinit mokit titiŋ didimeniŋdok Mede Momooŋ yenihautawaak.
Adi tosiwe tiŋa kutifiye mu tibaak, be mede yowawaliweŋ miŋgoŋ mu yohautawaak.
Adi yadi yat koliknit filodokokut mu tibaak. Be kudupdelet datumutumule tilak u bikabune mu kumumbaak. Adi unduŋ titaulune titiŋ didimeniŋdi fafaŋedapmawaak.
Kaŋ metam fekhinit mokit hogohogok, adi wou gineŋ welehikdi nadisukilitiŋa nemek kedem mintayembaak wendok nadisuŋa gigine tiŋa woomiyaneeŋ.”

content: Jesu Sadaŋ gut kwanai tilak niŋgiŋ
Nai uŋaniŋ me niŋ yabapdi tubukadakaune dawi sipmaka tuguk, tiŋa undugoŋ mede maaŋ mu yoluguk u nagila Jesu’walaŋ ugiŋ. Uune Jesudi tubukedebaune mede yoŋa dau diwe tuguk.
Kaŋ mebop kakaŋ yakiŋ adi u kaŋ boho tiŋa yogiŋ, “Dewit mihiŋiŋ iŋakoŋ bidak?”
Unduŋ yogiŋ kaŋ Falisi hekidibo u nadiŋa yeniŋgiŋ, “Yalaŋ mu yoneŋ ale wabiut. Me i yabap heki’walaŋ wapumhik Belisibudi tubulodaune yabap yeniŋkuyaulak.”

Iŋgoŋ Jesu adi nadinadihik u kanadiŋa indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Kwet wapum niŋ adi utawaaŋ bop molomolom tiŋa mindobuneŋ kaŋ kwet u pilap kadakawek. Be hekinolit niŋ adi daneeŋ molomolom hatiŋa mindobu tubune lekiŋgoŋhik foloŋ utawa utawa hali kadakawek.
Sadaŋ’walaŋ mebopdi utawaaŋ bop lufom tiŋa mindobu tubune adi’walaŋ kwanai deti saŋiniŋnit halek?

“Hidi nu Sadaŋdi saŋiniŋ nambune yabap yehikelelat yoiŋ, ale nu undugoŋ nobu tilit kaŋ me hide’walahi adi maŋgoŋ saŋiniŋdi yehitubu-lodaune yabap yehikeleiŋ? Hidi yalaŋ yoiŋ doktiŋa hide’walaŋ me nohiyedi mebihik tubudakaleiŋ.
Nu adi Bepaŋ’walaŋ Munabulidi nobu nehitubu-lodaune yabap heki yehikelelit kaŋ hidi Bepaŋ’walaŋ hebeŋ foloŋ Hatihati Kobulidi agaŋ hehitubu-dulalak u agaŋ mintadakalelak.
“Nebek niŋ me fafaŋeniŋ’walaŋ yoli ubulagineeŋ bomboŋ kubo tibe nadiŋa timeŋ me u tawa tiŋa ibikilitiune halune yoli kedem ubulaginewek.
Nebek niŋ menot mu tinamulak adi mik tinamulak, be nebek niŋdi mu nehitubu-lodaaŋ kwanaine kadokolak adi metamneye yehitubu-pupuhene tilak.

Tiŋa indiŋ hanilat. Nebek niŋdi kadakaniŋ tibaak, be me noli niŋkadaka tibaak, adi Bepaŋdi kadakaniŋŋiŋ kedem bimimbaak. Iŋgoŋ nebek niŋdi Uŋgoniŋ Munabuli niŋkadaka tibaak adi kadakaniŋŋiŋ mu bimimbaak.
Tiŋa nebek niŋdi Me Kobumuŋ niŋkadaka tibaak adi kadakaniŋŋiŋ kedem tumolokulimimbaak. Iŋgoŋ nebek niŋdi Uŋgoniŋ Munabuli niŋkadaka tibaak adi kadakaniŋŋiŋ hogok kameune haliwooŋ halaak fafaŋeniŋ.”
Bem hogohi adi folooŋ maaŋ hogohi iŋgoŋ mintaiŋ
Jesudi tomboyoula indiŋ yoguk, “Bem niŋdok miminiŋ yokaaŋ mindipmuŋdok maaŋ momooŋ yoyaneeŋ. Be bem niŋdok moiniŋ yokaaŋ mindipmuŋdok maaŋ hogoli yoyaneeŋ. Bem diniŋ mebi kilikidi tubudakalelak.
Hidi adi miŋgembet diniŋ yalaki doktiŋa mede momooŋ detiŋa yoneŋ? Welehik maaneŋ dediniŋ hatak wendok tuwot mahikdi yobihitak.
Me momooŋ adi weleŋ gineŋ nemek momooŋ hatak u miŋgoŋ yobihitak, eŋ me hogoli adi weleŋ maaneŋ nemek hogoli hatak u miŋgoŋ yobihiletik.
“Indiŋ hanimbe nadineŋ. Mede hogohi u mu nadidakaleeŋ hogok yofit tiiŋ wendok kibikoŋ kougoŋ nai wapum foloŋ Bepaŋdi hanindapmawaak.
Medege yolaŋ wendigoŋ mebige yobihilune ganagitdok, be medege yolaŋ wendigoŋ mebige yobihilune bigabudok.”
Me nolidi Jesu kunumneniŋ kudi tubune kakaŋdok ninadigiŋ
Unduŋ yenimbu Yodoko Mede henale noli tiŋa Falisi hekidibo indiŋ niŋgiŋ, “Henale, du Bepaŋ’walaaniŋ biyagoŋ nobu foweŋ kaŋ kudi neeŋ tubune saŋiniŋge kanim.”
Unduŋ yogiŋ kaŋ yeniŋguk, “Metam kobuhi hidi kadakaniŋ titiŋdigoŋ kunum gineniŋ kudi titiŋdok naniiŋ. Iŋgoŋ kudi gitipmuŋ nemoŋ. Kudi adi koom polofet Jona’walaŋ mintaguk undugoŋ mintaune kaneeŋ.
Koom Jonadi helebufa lufomkulitniŋ pisi wapum weleŋ maaneŋ hakuk undugoŋ Me Kobumuŋ adi maaŋ koŋ maaneŋ helebufa lufomkulitniŋ halaak.

Nai wapum mintaune mede nadinadi halaakneŋ Niniwehidi mintaaŋ hidi’walaŋ mebihik yobihilune tuwaŋiŋ beneeŋ. Maŋgoŋde, adi koom Jonadi Bepaŋ’walaŋ mede yohautaune metam adi u nadiŋa welehik tubutakalegiŋ. Iŋgoŋ Me niŋ hebehik foloŋ yatak adi Jona kalakapme tilak.

“Tiŋa Sebahi’walaŋ Tam Wapme loloŋnit adi yolikweli biŋa pilali Mapme Solomondi mede nadisu-fuliŋgoŋ tiŋa yoguk u nadiwene uguk. Ale indiŋ hanimbe nadineŋ. Kobuk hebehik foloŋ yatak adi Solomon kalakapme tilak doktiŋa Bepaŋ’walaŋ nai wapum foloŋ Sebahi’walaŋ Tam Wapme adi pilali metam kobuhi hidi’walaŋ mebihik yobihilune kadakaniŋhik diniŋ kibikoŋ beneeŋ.”
Munabuli hogolidi kotigoŋ udaneguk
Unduŋ yoŋa tomboyoula indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Yabap adi me niŋ weleŋ gineniŋ labuŋa wooŋ kwet ime moŋ gineŋ, kwet fiileŋ hakule titiŋdok kwet lohitaulak.
Lohitawooŋ moŋ lohikaaŋ indiŋ yobetik, ‘Kotigoŋ wooŋ yotneneŋ fowit.’ Unduŋ yoŋa udaneeŋ wooŋ kalune yot u molomnit mokit yohumuŋ tiŋa tutumbaaŋ biŋit

unduŋ kaŋ kotigoŋ wooŋ yabap kadakahi hinek 7 yanagila buŋa uŋgoŋ noŋgoŋ fooŋ itounetiŋit. Unduŋ tubune me u koom yabap kubugoŋdi fomimbu hatiguk undiniŋ u wabiŋa agaŋ kisaŋ hinek kadakawetik. Undugoŋ hinek, metam kobuhi kadakaniŋ titiŋ hidi’walaŋ mintawaak.”
Jesu miŋ kwayaŋiye
Jesu adi mede unduŋ hayenilune miŋ kwayaŋiye adi mede ninene bugiŋ, buŋa fakaŋ yakiŋ.
Kaŋ me niŋdi niŋguk, “Maŋge kwayageye mede ganine fakaŋ woomgamiiŋ.”
Unduŋ yobune Jesudibo indiŋ niŋguk, “Maane kwayaneye nedigoŋ?”
Unduŋ yoŋa mihiŋiye yakiŋneŋkade kohodidim youla indiŋ yoguk, “Nu maane kwayaneye adi iŋak.
Metam nediyeŋ Batne kunum gineŋ hatilak’walaŋ maŋiŋ mede nadiŋa takaliiŋ adi yadi nu’walaŋ maaneye, kwayaneye eŋ witneye.”
